'No insider has bought' stands; 'the loudest signal in the file and it points down' does not. (3) SEASONAL NET-DEBT SNAPSHOT - MINOR, checked and dismissed. value_memo:
RUBRIC WEIGHTING. Four pillars of roughly 25 points each: margin of safety on the reconciled sum-of-the-parts (valuing each business line separately) as the system of record; the cyclical-peak versus durable-growth test applied before any cheapness is credited; solvency judged on funded, interest-bearing debt only (settlement float and policyholder reserves excluded, the classic bankruptcy score ignored); and multiples against true peers combined with growth durability and returns on capital. The deep-dive credibility gate and the moat-erosion sizing caps override everything: a factor-cheap name never outranks a forensic exclusion. A note on this week's inputs: the five-method model spread was not re-computed for most of the pool, so where the raw screen also shows no cheapness the sole-evidence sizing rule (half unit maximum) was applied — HRB and SCR.PA in the basket, BCRX among the alternates. For HRB, our valuation beats the silent screen because the raw margin (about -27%) capitalizes a seasonal trough and ignores 25% returns on capital, while our sum-of-the-parts builds from full-cycle cash earnings. For SCR.PA, the raw -7% penalizes reserve float as if it were borrowing; on the funded-debt basis the 38-euro mid-cycle value stands. For BCRX, first-year profitability means the trailing screens have nothing to grip, and our value rests on the durability of Orladeyo's cash flow.

CORRELATION STRESS (argued against the measured numbers: average pairwise co-movement last run 0.17, maximum EEFT-CTSH at 0.41, no pair at or above 0.6). (1) AI-displacement theme, WKL.AS + HRB: two names, but Wolters Kluwer is a wide, non-eroding anchor and counts at half toward the theme budget, so the theme carries one durable anchor plus one stable-moat leg — within budget. Kept with a numeric combined cap of 1.3 units on the theme axis. IT and VNT, which would have made it three-plus legs, were left as alternates partly for this reason. (2) Insurance rate-and-credit, LNC + SCR.PA: a life insurer and a reinsurer share rate, credit and reserve-adequacy sensitivity even though their liabilities differ; kept, both at half units, under a numeric combined cap of 1.0 — their reserve cycles (long-term-care runoff versus catastrophe pricing) are largely independent, but a rate shock hits both, so the cap makes the shared exposure explicit. SREN.SW was not seated precisely because it would re-cluster with SCOR. (3) US healthcare utilization, THC + BSX: hospitals and device makers both ride procedure volumes, though the reimbursement mechanics differ — Tenet carries the 2028 Medicaid supplemental-payment binary directly while Boston Scientific's device revenue is global and payer-diversified; kept under a numeric combined cap of 1.25 units, with Tenet already at the erosion half-cap. (4) Hospital-reimbursement pair THC + UHS: resolved by diversification — UHS stays out (dropped 2 July 2026, and no documented thesis change since), so the 2028 ruling touches one leg only, at a half unit. ARDT was likewise not considered, for the same re-clustering reason. (5) Advertising-cycle pair CMCSA + SAX.DE: moot — neither is seated; CMCSA remains an alternate and SAX.DE, dropped 10 June, has no documented thesis change to justify a re-add. (7) The measured maximum pair, EEFT + CTSH at 0.41: both are seated, but at 0.75 and 0.6 units on different demand drivers (consumer cash and remittance corridors versus enterprise IT budgets); 0.41 is moderate, below the 0.6 flag line, and the combined 1.35 units across the two is accepted without a formal cap. No hidden factor carries two full-size legs anywhere in the book.

BEAR REBUTTAL (the strongest single reason each seat is wrong, written before final sizing). EEFT: the reviewer showed the recorded cash netting overstates distributable cash by roughly $770 million of machine-vault float, and on that corrected basis the shares trade near or above fair value rather than below it. WKL.AS: if corporate customers begin drafting legal and tax research from general-purpose AI, subscription renewals could erode faster than the cushion can absorb. CTSH: AI-written code deflates billable hours across outsourced IT services, so the cheap multiple may be the market correctly pricing a shrinking revenue pool. HRB: assisted tax preparation is exactly the kind of form-filling work consumer AI could commoditize, and without our sum-of-the-parts the screen shows no cheapness at all. DECK: fashion-driven footwear reigns are short, and with earnings far above their multi-year base a HOKA deceleration would compress the earnings and the multiple together. NTES: a hit-driven games franchise exposed to Chinese regulatory whim with only a roughly 10% cushion offers little compensation if the pipeline disappoints. LNC: the one dated event — Bain's $44 investment — fired over a year ago and the stock still trades below that price, suggesting the discount to book is earned rather than a mispricing. SCR.PA: at nearly 90% of its 52-week range with an 8% cushion, the market has already repriced the reinsurance recovery and any reserve surprise lands on a thin margin. THC: the 2028 Medicaid supplemental-payment ruling is a binary that could remove the cushion at a stroke, and the downside to the adverse case is roughly triple the upside. BSX: the thesis leans on 20% growth persisting at a premium-quality franchise, and any slowdown in device adoption compresses both the earnings and the multiple at once.
